findings.claim: Non-agent standard server creates one promql.Engine with feature flag and startup timeout, passes it through rules.EngineQueryFunc to manager; groups retain manager options.

Query-engine reloader captures startup enableQueryCost flag outside shadowed config parameter and conditionally applies global series/sample/duration values via SetQueryLimits; agent mode returns early.

EngineQueryFunc calls NewInstantQuery with nil options, defers query.Close and propagates construction/execution error; recording and alerting Eval use this callback, group marks errors unhealthy and records failures.

Nil query options become zero-override PrometheusQueryOpts; feature-enabled newQuery therefore inherits operator limits. Nonzero configured duration replaces startup timeout; zero configuration without override retains startup timeout.

Feature-enabled evaluation constructs and passes a shared budget; positive limits are enforced with > checks, not >=. This supports exposure of the selected rule query to the engine limit branches, not measured time/error outcomes.
